tags.lyrics-eng:
I’m not a rabbit I’m a devil I don’t know how to spell devil
Rabbit

Got more rabbit than Sainsbury’s

Rock the square

Oh, you read Stephen Warfel’s,
I’d actually believe it And it goes in...
We love big boys
We love big boys
You think I shake your hand,
you piece of shit?

You want to get yourself down to Rose Hill?

Sorry?
It’s a temperance... What happened to your soapbox?

I think you’re really wonderful
I think you’re really wonderful

Thank you

Why can’t men fucking dance?
Can we get in the middle,
please?

I’m not a girl

I was quite aware of that beforehand

Death

Love
Abandon
Three things we consider
Death
Love
Abandon

He’s dancing

He could be dancing, yeah

Wait, wait, wait
Wait until any girls who want to dance and they’re being pushed around by these fucking beer boys at the front

If you’re a beer boy and you want to say, come up here
I’m not a beer boy because I like Kingmaker Oh, your politics are made up,
darling

We just don’t want to dance next to you because you fucking smell

You smell

Don’t put your hand to me,
you fucking grubby monkey

Listen, we’ve really worked out this really cool bit of jazz music
If you want to come up and say your piece and you’re a bit shy, we can play this fucking great riff behind you
If you want to come up and say what you’ve got to say...

It’s fine, I swear, it’s the greatest little bass line, I swear Can we have this boy just up on stage because he’s so knowledgeable?
Come on, it’s time to place your meaning, come on
Come on, this is the boy who’s holding up your evening and now he’s too scared
And he’s got spit in his hair

What?

We’re giving you the fucking opportunity to get on stage

Should have been in Rose Hill

We’re too shy
You’re not too shy to push girls smaller than you around though, are you?
How delightful, how delightful

We’ll take as long as we want and these are the people who are holding you up

Dance properly because you’ve paid to see them, so what’s the point of fucking waving your head about?

Don’t spit on me, it’s okay,
it’s what happens

You’re giving us an advert against masturbation and deodorant is all you’re giving us
